articles.text: PEDRO: Get up, Jaime! It's five o'clock.
JAIME: No me molestes. Estoy muy cansado.
JAIME: Don't bother me. I'm very tired.
PEDRO: No seas flojo, ya es tarde.
PEDRO: Don't be lazy, it's late already.
JAIME: Mejor déjalo para otro día. Además, tengo dolor de cabeza.
JAIME: Better put it off for another day. Besides, I have a headache.
PEDRO: No te quejes tanto y vístete.
PEDRO: Don't complain so much and get dressed.
JAIME: Bueno, me voy a levantar; pero es primera y última vez.
JAIME: All right, I'm going to get up; but it's the first and last time.
